z: 参数化模型 + 监督学习 有些事写不出 if-else：「这是猫吗」「下一句说什么」。换个办法：先给一个能拧的旋钮，再用例子把旋钮拧对。 怎么用概率描述“下一个字”？
e: A model with parameters + supervised learning Some tasks beat if-else: “is this a cat?”, “what comes next?”. Give a tunable function, then twist its knobs with

z: 分布、条件概率、均值方差、高斯 AI 每猜一个字，其实是在说「接下来每个字有多大可能」。 概率 就是给可能性打分的语言。 怎么判断参数好不好？
e: Distributions, conditionals, mean/variance, Gaussians Every next-token guess is really “how likely is each word next?”. Probability is that language. How do we

z: 均方误差、极大似然、交叉熵 模型每猜一次，都要先知道“这次错了多少”。没有这个数，它就不知道该往哪改。 损失函数 就是给每次猜测打的“罚分”，训练就是让罚分越来越小。 怎么找到让损失最小的参数？
e: Mean squared error, maximum likelihood, cross-entropy Every time the model guesses, it first needs to know “how wrong was that?”. Without that number it cannot

z: 沿负梯度一步步调 大模型有几十亿个参数，不可能一个个去试。 梯度下降 就是“蒙着眼下山”：每一步只看脚下哪边最陡，就往下迈一小步。所有大模型都是这样训练出来的。 线性模型能力不够
e: Step against the gradient, again and again A large model has billions of parameters; you cannot try them one by one. Gradient descent is “walking downhill blind

z: 隐藏层 + 激活函数 只会画直线的模型，分不开「异或」这种题。要更强，就得加层，并且加上 弯曲 。 多层网络的梯度怎么求？
e: Hidden layers + activation functions A straight line cannot separate XOR. Stack layers and bend them with non-linearities. How do we get gradients through many

z: 链式法则；ReLU、残差、归一化 多层网络里，前面一层的旋钮怎么调？不能靠猜——要用 链式法则 从后往前传「谁害损失变大」。 训练又慢又不稳，还会过拟合
e: The chain rule; ReLU, residuals, normalisation How do early knobs get their gradients? The chain rule , run backwards efficiently — backprop. Training is slow,

z: 小批量 SGD、Adam、正则化、验证集 数据上百万时，每步看完全部太慢；还要防「背题」（过拟合）。 文字这类离散符号怎么输入？
e: Mini-batch SGD, Adam, regularisation, validation set Millions of samples: do not scan all every step; also avoid memorising. How do discrete symbols like words

z: 用上下文学嵌入 电脑不认「猫」这个字，只认数。怎么把字变成 带意思的数 ？ 词义固定；序列怎么处理？
e: Learn embeddings from context Computers need numbers, not the word “cat”. Learn vectors that carry meaning ; decide token size with BPE . One fixed meaning per

z: 循环状态；注意力缓解瓶颈 句子有长短、有顺序。RNN 一步步读，但记不住太远，也不能并行； 注意力 让每一步直接回看全部。 不能并行，长依赖仍然难
e: A recurrent state; attention eases the bottleneck Sequences vary in length. RNNs read step by step but forget and cannot parallelise; attention looks at all pos

z: Q/K/V、√d 缩放、因果遮罩 “小猫坐在垫子上，因为 它 很累。”“它”是谁？人一眼就知道是小猫。AI 能读懂句子，靠的就是这一招： 注意力 。 一层注意力还不够：怎么搭成能叠很多层的完整模型？
e: Q/K/V, √d scaling, causal mask “The cat sat on the mat as it was tired.” Who is “it”? You know at a glance: the cat. The trick that lets AI read sentences like

z: 多头、FFN、残差、归一化、位置 注意力只是一个零件。真正的大模型像一栋楼：同一种“楼层”（解码块）叠几十层。每层做两件事：先 交流 （注意力），再 各自消化 （前馈网络）。 用什么数据、多大规模去训练？
e: Heads, FFN, residuals, normalisation, position Attention is only one part. A real large model is like a tower: the same kind of floor (a decoder block) stacked

z: 下一个词元预测 + 扩大规模 架构有了，用什么任务吞下海量文本？答案： 猜下一个词元 ；顺带学会 采样 ——从概率变成一句话。 训好了，怎么知道它有多强、哪里还不行？
e: Next-token prediction + scale With the architecture ready, train by next-token prediction , and learn sampling to turn probabilities into text. Once trained, ho

z: 基准、困惑度、污染、人评 训完模型，不能靠感觉说「它变强了」。 评估 就是用固定的尺子量一量。 会续写，但不听指令、不安全
e: Benchmarks, perplexity, contamination, judges Do not trust vibes — evaluate with fixed rulers. It continues text but won’t follow instructions or stay safe

z: SFT、RLHF/DPO、推理型强化学习 基座只会续写。要让它听指令、更安全、还会「先想再答」——靠 后训练 。 定制成本太高
e: SFT, RLHF/DPO, reasoning RL A base model only continues text. Post-training makes it follow instructions, stay safer, and think before answering. Customising it

z: LoRA、量化 全量微调太贵。能不能只动一小块？ LoRA ；能不能把每个数存短一点？ 量化 。 生成慢，显存占用大
e: LoRA, quantisation Full fine-tuning is costly. LoRA trains a thin side path; quantisation stores fewer bits. Generation is slow and memory-hungry

z: KV 缓存、GQA/MLA、FlashAttention、投机解码、MoE 生成只能一个字一个字来。怎样少算、少占显存？ KV 缓存 、共享 KV、FlashAttention、投机解码、MoE。 知识过期，会产生幻觉
e: KV cache, GQA/MLA, FlashAttention, speculative decoding, MoE Generation is serial. KV cache , shared KV, FlashAttention, speculative decoding, MoE cut work and

z: 先检索再生成 模型会过期、会编。别逼它背—— 开卷考试 ：先检索再生成。 只会说，不会做
e: Retrieve, then generate Models go stale and invent. Open-book : retrieve, then generate. It can talk but not act

z: 函数调用、Agent 循环、MCP 只会说不够，还要会 做 ：查天气、改日历。模型只写调用，程序去执行。 会做事了，但会被骗、越权、泄漏
e: Function calling, the agent loop, MCP Talking is not enough — act : call tools. The model writes the call; a program runs it. It can act, but can be tricked, ov

z: 提示注入、越狱、权限、人在回路 助手一旦能 做事 ，安全就从「别说坏话」变成「别做坏事」。 只能处理文字，世界不只有文字
e: Injection, jailbreaks, permissions, human-in-the-loop Once it can act , safety means “don’t do bad things”. Text only — the world is more than text

z: VLM、扩散、语音 世界不只有字：截图、照片、声音也要懂。 回答时怎么多想一会？长文怎么接住？
e: VLMs, diffusion, speech The world is more than text: screenshots, photos, speech. How to think longer at answer time? How to handle long text?

z: 推理时计算、长窗口、端侧 难问题想让它多想一会；长文档想一次读完。 这些能力现在都用在哪？
e: Test-time compute, long windows, on-device Hard problems want longer thinking; long docs want wider windows. Where are these abilities used today?

z: 编程助手、研究、电脑操作、端侧 学完原理，最想知道的是： 现在能用来干嘛？ 答案是把前面的站拼起来。 仍在发展中
e: Coding, research, computer use, on-device After the principles: what can we do with it? Orchestrate the stations. Still moving

z: 一条链串起全部 整条链可以收成一句话：用样本找函数，一路被问题逼到 Agent 与应用。
e: One chain for all of it One sentence holds the chain: from fitting a function to agents and apps, each step answering the last gap.

z: 读进前面的一串字，算出「下一个字」是字典里每个字的概率。
e: Reads the text so far and computes, for every token in the dictionary, the probability that it is the next one.

z: 把一段文字切成一个个 token，并换成字典里的编号。
e: Cuts a piece of text into tokens and replaces each with its id in the dictionary.

z: 把每个 token 编号换成一串数字（向量），用数字来表达这个字的意思。
e: Replaces each token id by a list of numbers (a vector) that expresses the meaning of the character.

z: 告诉模型每个字排在第几位。
e: Tells the model where each character stands in the sequence.

z: 让每个字的数字吸收上下文、再加工一遍；叠很多层，逐步理解更深的含义。
e: Lets each character's numbers take in the context and get processed once more; stacking many blocks builds up deeper meaning step by step.

z: 让每个字同时从几个角度，去前面的字里找有用的信息并吸收进来。
e: Lets every character look back at the earlier characters from several angles at once, find useful information and take it in.

z: 算出每个字该从前面每个字拿多少信息，再按比例把内容取过来。
e: Works out how much each character should take from each earlier character, then fetches their content in those proportions.

z: 保证每个字只能看见自己和前面的字，看不见后面的字。
e: Makes sure every character can only see itself and the characters before it, never the ones after.

z: 残差：把输入原样加到输出上，信息不丢；归一化：把数字调回统一大小，训练更稳。
e: Residual: add the input unchanged to the output so nothing is lost; normalisation: bring the numbers back to a common size so training is stable.

z: 对每个字的数字单独做一次非线性加工，把注意力拿到的信息再提炼一遍。
e: Processes each character's numbers on its own with a non-linear step, refining what attention brought in.

z: 给字典里每个 token 打一个分数（logit），分越高越可能是下一个字。
e: Gives every token in the dictionary a score (a logit); the higher the score, the likelier it is the next character.

z: 把一组任意大小的分数，变成全是正数、加起来 100% 的概率。
e: Turns a set of scores of any size into probabilities that are all positive and add up to 100%.

z: 用一个数衡量「模型给正确答案的概率有多低」，训练就是要把它降低。
e: One number that measures how low the model put the right answer ; training means pushing it down.

z: 算出每个参数对损失「负多少责任」（梯度），再把每个参数往损失变小的方向挪一小步。
e: Works out how much each parameter is to blame for the loss (its gradient), then moves every parameter a small step in the direction that lowers the loss.

z: 一次出一个字，接到末尾再猜下一个，直到写完；温度控制回答是稳妥还是多样。
e: Produces one character at a time, appends it and guesses the next, until done; temperature sets whether the answer is safe or varied.

z: Transformer 之前处理序列的主流办法；看懂它的两个毛病，就明白注意力为什么出现。
e: The main way to handle sequences before the Transformer; its two flaws explain why attention appeared.

z: 用一串数字表示一个字的意思，让「意思」可以拿来计算。
e: Uses a list of numbers to stand for a character's meaning, so that meaning can be computed with.

z: 用一个数衡量两个向量有多「对齐」：注意力里给每对字打分，就靠它。
e: One number that measures how aligned two vectors are: attention scores every pair of characters with it.

z: 一次把所有字的向量一起变换、一起打分；模型的参数大多就是矩阵。
e: Transforms and scores the vectors of all characters at once; most of a model's parameters are matrices.

z: 注意力里把分数变成「关注多少」；输出端把字典里每个字的分数变成概率。
e: In attention it turns scores into how much to attend ; at the output it turns every dictionary character's score into a probability.

z: eˣ 让 softmax 把分数变正数；ln 让交叉熵把「乘一串概率」变成「加一串数」。
e: eˣ lets softmax make scores positive; ln lets cross-entropy turn multiply a chain of probabilities into add a list of numbers .

z: 给「模型猜得好不好」定一个目标：训练数据里的真实下一个字，概率要尽量高。
e: Sets a goal for how well the model guesses : the real next characters in the training data should get probabilities as high as possible.

z: 用一个数说清这次猜错了多少，训练就是让它变小。
e: One number saying how wrong this guess was; training makes it smaller.

z: 告诉每个参数：往哪边改、改多少，损失会下降。
e: Tells every parameter which way and how much to change so the loss goes down.

z: 一次倒推，就算出所有参数的梯度。
e: One backward pass computes the gradients of all parameters.

z: 把参数一步步挪到损失低的地方，这就是「训练」。
e: Moves the parameters step by step to where the loss is low — that is training .

z: 把每个字的那串数拉回统一尺度（平均 0、方差 1），层多了也不乱跑。
e: Pulls each character's numbers back to a common scale (mean 0, variance 1) so they do not run off as layers pile up.

z: 把点积缩回正常大小，让 softmax 不至于把注意力全给一个字。
e: Shrinks dot products back to a normal size so softmax does not give all the attention to one character.

z: 让训练更快、更稳，并且在没见过的新题上也答得好（不过拟合）。
e: Makes training faster and steadier, and keeps answers good on new questions it has never seen (no overfitting).

z: 大模型预测下一个词元，本质上就是在算 条件概率 P(下一个字 | 前文)。
e: Predicting the next token is computing the conditional probability P(next | context).

z: 听懂你的一句话，自己拆步骤、调工具，把事情真正办完。
e: Understands one sentence from you, breaks it into steps, calls tools, and actually gets the job done.

z: 让大模型准确知道：你要什么、现在是什么情况。
e: Lets the large model know exactly what you want and what the situation is.

z: 把「订票」这样的大目标，拆成一步步能执行的小步骤。
e: Turns a big goal like “book a ticket” into small steps that can each be carried out.

z: 让助手通过程序接口（API）真的去查票、下单，而不是凭空编答案。
e: Lets the assistant really look up tickets and place orders through program interfaces (APIs), instead of making answers up.

z: 防止助手乱花钱、做错不可撤回的事，或被网页里的坏指令骗。
e: Stops the assistant from spending money carelessly, doing something wrong that can’t be undone, or being fooled by bad instructions hidden in a web page.

z: 说明助手由哪些部件组成，每个部件负责什么。
e: Shows which parts the assistant is made of and what each one does.

z: 你可以直接拍照问「这个零件叫什么」，或者用语音聊天：图片和声音也是助手的输入。
e: You can snap a photo and ask “what is this part called?”, or chat by voice: pictures and sound are inputs too.

z: 让大模型一步一步把事办完，而不是一次性回答。
e: Lets the large model get the job done step by step instead of answering in one go.

z: 让大模型「看到」做决定需要的一切。
e: Lets the large model “see” everything it needs to decide.

z: 让大模型决定下一步具体做什么，并说清原因。
e: Lets the large model decide exactly what to do next, and say why.

z: 看工具结果，判断任务完成没有、要不要改计划。
e: Looks at the tool result and judges whether the task is done or the plan needs changing.

z: 保存这次对话里的每一步，让模型知道之前做过什么。
e: Keeps every step of this conversation so the model knows what has already been done.

z: 跨对话保存你的习惯和资料，需要时找出相关的几条交给模型。
e: Keeps your habits and documents across conversations, and when needed finds the few relevant ones for the model.

z: 读进上下文，写出想法、行动和给你的回复。
e: Reads the context and writes thoughts, actions and replies to you.

z: 决定什么时候结束循环：完成了、需要你确认、或出问题了。
e: Decides when to end the loop: the job is done, it needs your confirmation, or something has gone wrong.

z: 会调工具之后，安全从「别说坏话」变成「别做坏事」。
e: Once it can call tools, safety shifts from “don’t say bad things” to “don’t do bad things”.

z: 知道「现在能用来干嘛」，并且能拆回前面的站讲清原理。
e: Know what you can do with it today, and map each use back to the stations that explain it.

zh: 推理时计算与长上下文
z: 同一套 Transformer，用的时候多想一会，或一次读完整份资料。
e: Same Transformer — just think longer at use time, or read a whole document at once.

z: 读进一段文字，一个字一个字地接着往下写；回答、写作、翻译、写代码都靠这一个本事。
e: Reads in some text and keeps writing it, one char at a time; answering, writing, translating and coding all rest on this one skill.

zh: 预训练语料与数据清洗
z: 给模型准备学习材料：量要大、种类要多、质量要好。
e: Prepares the material the model learns from: large in amount, varied in kind, good in quality.

z: 在训练开始前定下「文字 ↔ 编号」对照表；训练和使用都查这同一本。
e: Fixes a “text ↔ number” table before training starts; training and use both look up this same book.

z: 让模型在海量文字里自己练「猜下一个字」，把语言规律和知识存进参数。
e: Lets the model practise “guess the next char” on mass text by itself, storing language patterns and knowledge in the parameters.

z: 提前估算：模型、数据、算力放大后，损失能降到多少；预算固定时，怎么分配最划算。
e: Estimates in advance how low the loss can go when model, data and compute grow, and how best to split a fixed budget.

z: 让只会「续写」的预训练模型，学会听指令、按格式好好回答。
e: Teaches a pre-trained model that can only “continue text” to follow instructions and answer properly, in format.

z: 让回答更符合人的期望：更有用、更诚实、更无害。
e: Makes answers closer to what people want: more helpful, more honest, more harmless.

z: 训练学到的全部「知识」都存成这些数字；使用时只读不改。
e: Everything training learns is stored as these numbers; in use they are only read, never changed.

z: 用训练好的参数，把你的话一个字一个字接着写下去，直到写完。
e: Uses the trained parameters to continue your words one char at a time until it is done.

z: 规定模型一次最多能「看见」多少个 token：你的问题、之前的对话、它已写出的回答都算在内。
e: Sets how many tokens the model can “see” at once at most: your question, the earlier chat and the answer it has written so far all count.

z: 决定从「下一个字的概率」里具体选哪个字：要稳妥，还是要多样。
e: Decides which char to actually pick from the “next char” odds: safe, or varied.

z: 了解它为什么会出现，学会用提示词和检索来减少它。
e: Understand why it happens, and learn to reduce it with prompts and retrieval.

z: 让普通显卡也能微调和运行大模型：要训练的参数少几百倍，存参数的显存省一半以上。
e: Lets an ordinary GPU fine-tune and run a big model: hundreds of times fewer parameters to train, and less than half the memory for the parameters.

zh: 推理加速与 KV 缓存
en: Faster inference and the KV cache
z: 让生成从「每步把整段重算一遍」变成「每步只算新来的一个词元」。
e: Turns generation from “recompute the whole text every step” into “compute only the one new token every step”.

z: 不知道评估，就看不懂「哪个模型更强」的新闻，也做不好 Agent。
e: Without evaluation you cannot read “which model is stronger” news, or build a good agent.

zh: 蚂蚁发布 Ling-3.2-flash：总参数 5600 亿，每步只算其中约 250 亿，上下文 100 万词元，能读文字、图和视频。
